facts.business: Omnitech Engineering Limited is a scaled precision-engineering platform manufacturing high-precision engineered components and assemblies for safety-critical industries including Energy (oil & gas, wind, power), Motion Control and Automation, Industrial Equipment Systems and Others, operating three manufacturing facilities in Rajkot, Gujarat with a warehouse in Houston, USA.
